essence: Even great sages and gods possess only partial knowledge of this matter.
Ignorance of this teaching results in repeated birth in low worm births.
Mastery of this practice confers the power to create the three worlds.
One who performs this eating becomes the lord of supernatural powers.
Both sattvic and rajasic practitioners can grasp the threefold aim.
